quest.title: Pioneers
quest.description: You catch sight of Columbina in the distance on a deserted island on the east side of Piramida. Worried that your friend has encountered trouble, you chase after her, and in so doing, embark on an adventure into the unknown...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... It was no problem for you in the end! That should take care of things, right?

dialogues.speaker: Main Control Terminal
dialogues.text: Alert! Main Control Hall Defender Core destruction confirmed. Initiating self-destruct mode.

dialogues.speaker: Main Control Terminal
dialogues.text: All personnel, please evacuate immediately. Initiating countdown...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously!? This base has gone crazy! It's trying to take us down with it... What should we do?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What if some really important intel gets destroyed!?

dialogues.speaker: Main Control Terminal
dialogues.text: Please verify orbital coordinates.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What orbital coordinates? Whoa! Our mystery kuuhenki's back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are you doing? Will giving it the coordinates stop the base from self-destructing!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are the coordinates? Don't panic, don't panic, let Paimon think!

dialogues.speaker: Main Control Terminal
dialogues.text: Please verify orbital coordinates.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon remembers now... There were three symbols! The <color=#00E1FFFF>simplest-looking</color> one was first!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The second symbol had a <color=#00E1FFFF>super complicated</color> shape!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And lastly... Paimon can't quite remember, but it was probably the <color=#00E1FFFF>same as the second one</color>!

response.speaker: Main Control Terminal
response.text: Orbital coordinate verification error.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no! Did Paimon get the last one wrong? Okay. Don't panic, don't panic! Let's try again, real quick!

response.speaker: Main Control Terminal
response.text: Please re-verify orbital coordinates.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: One more time! First up, the <color=#00E1FFFF>simplest</color> symbol!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The second one's <color=#00E1FFFF>the most complicated</color>!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And the last one is... the last one is... Argh, what in Teyvat is the last one...?

response.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
response.text: #It's <size=30><color=#FCD899>{REGEX#UNICODE[E001]}</color></size>

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ooh! Yes, yes! <color=#FCD899>{REGEX#UNICODE[E001]}</color>. That's the one! Wait. Who said that...? Ah, whatever! Let's punch it in!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #<size=30><color=#FCD899>{REGEX#UNICODE[E001]}</color></size>

response.speaker: System Voice
response.text: Orbital coordinate verification: Successful. Engine ignition in progress. Please board the lunar spacecraft immediately.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did we make it? Why's the alarm still going off!?

response.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
response.text: ...Colum—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Was it you talking just now? Hey! Were you about to say "Columbina"?

response.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
response.text: ...The moon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: On the moon? What... Has something happened to her?

response.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
response.text: ...Rescue...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Rescue!? Is she asking us to go save Columbina!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is Columbina in trouble?

response.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
response.text: ...Spaceship... Moon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Take the spaceship? To the moon? Hey! Explain yourself!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What are we gonna do?! It feels like this place is gonna blow up any second!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There's no time. Let's go with it to the spaceship.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no! It's too late!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You fail to stop the self-destruct sequence, and as the countdown ends, the base is engulfed in roaring flames.\nThe good news is you manage to escape the explosion unscathed with Paimon in tow.\nBut alas, the mysterious black kuuhenki, the spaceship bound for the moon, and the tale behind them all vanish from your journey forever.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've never been here before. Where is this, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Look! That person over there...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why's she here? Paimon thought she'd be at Silvermoon Hall...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh, funny how life works sometimes. Let's go over and say hi!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Columbina! Where are you going!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Agh, she's gone too far out. She can't hear us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But what's she doing here? Does she have something to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's follow her and take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. Paimon doesn't think she'll run into any trouble, but better safe than sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Celestial Orbit
dialogues.text: This vessel is bound for lunar orbit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, we blasted off for real! Paimon was expecting a regular ol' vanilla adventure... but here we are flying to the moon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! You! Tell us what's going on, will ya!? What sort of trouble has Columbina gotten into?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously? Playing dumb again!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Say something, or I'll throw you into space.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We definitely heard you speak just now, right? No, wait... You spoke through the base's systems, didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can't you speak yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, that's weird...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then how about... we take a look around this ship? Let's see if we can find something to help you talk.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: According to the route map, this should be the Main Control Hall, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! You! The one pretending to be Columbina! Come out right now!

dialogues.speaker: Main Control Terminal
dialogues.text: Alert! Intruder detected in Main Control Hall. Activating defense measures.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wah! Sorry! Wrong address, we were looking for someone else!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place looks like some sort of ruins...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. What are those rings? Looks like they've fallen onto the ground or something.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Some kinda device, I'd say.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that so? In that case, could this glowing sign next to it... be a manual, maybe?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon see...

dialogues.speaker: Ruins Guidepost
dialogues.text: Alert! Alert!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, darn it! Paimon triggered some kinda intruder alarm!

dialogues.speaker: Ruins Guidepost
dialogues.text: Alert! Alert!

dialogues.speaker: Ruins Guidepost
dialogues.text: Power transmission has ceased. Please head to the <color=#00E1FFFF>generator room</color> to activate backup power!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so it's just out of power! Gah, Paimon almost jumped outta her skin!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Reminds me of you when you're hungry, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? C—C'mon, Paimon's way classier than that!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go check this generator room out first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh, right! If Columbina came here to do something, she'd totally need to turn on the power first.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Right, and we might find her there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Haha, genius!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alrighty then! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. This thing... doesn't really look very mechanical, but given where we found it, it must be the key to getting the power on somehow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Paimon doesn't see how that's supposed to work...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It doesn't look like the power's been turned on yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, and that's super weird. Do you think Columbina's already been here? Maybe she discovered that the power wouldn't start, and went to look for a solution elsewhere?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm. Y'know what? Let's give this thing a try anyway. Maybe we can find out what's going on...

talks.objective: Find a way to activate the energy mechanisms
Find a way to activate the energy mechanisms

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why isn't anything happening?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon guessed as much... There's gotta be something else to this. Columbina must have run into this problem and then gone to look somewhere else... Huh!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C—Columbina!? Thank goodness, we finally found you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe... Surprised to see us? We were worried you might be in trouble, so we followed you here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you need help, Columbina?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Erm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...What's wrong? Are you trying to use telepathy, like Nicole? Just so you know, we aren't hearing anything!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you alright?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, now you're starting to worry Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is someone threatening you!? If that's the case, just blink...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What did you do?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Do you want us to activate this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's not sure what's going on, but it looks like Columbina wants us to activate this device. We should give it another try!

talks.objective: Find a way to activate the energy mechanisms

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Awesome! The energy channels are clear! How did you do that, Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait! Where are you going?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'd better catch up with her.

dialogues.speaker: Celestial Orbit
dialogues.text: Calculating celestial orbits. Please select the Trilune coordinates you wish to view.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Trilune coordinates!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so this device is used to work out where the moons are?

dialogues.speaker: Celestial Orbit
dialogues.text: Calculating celestial orbits. Please select the Trilune coordinates you wish to view.

response.speaker: Celestial Orbit
response.text: Connection lost... Failed to locate target...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, it actually found the Frost Moon... But why would they need those coordinates anyways?

response.speaker: Celestial Orbit
response.text: Frost Moon coordinates located. Base engineering blueprints and Main Control Hall route map have been transmitted.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! These look like schematics! Whatever these are showing, it looks super awesome!

response.speaker: Celestial Orbit
response.text: Do you wish to obtain the route map?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Obtain route map)

response.speaker: Celestial Orbit
response.text: Please proceed to the Main Control Hall for moon landing preparations.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: M—Moon landing preparations!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Columbina... is this place used for getting to the moon!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (But Columbina has taken me to the Frost Moon before... Why would she need this device?)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (And the power she just gave me is completely new. I've never seen her use it before...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! The door opened! This leads to the Main Control Hall, right? Columbina, is that where you want us to go?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Columbina, can you hold out your hand?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Place it in mine, just like we do in Silvermoon Hall.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's all this about?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Waaah! What's going on? Columbina turned into a black kuuhenki!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's not Columbina!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!? An impostor!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's go after her!

response.speaker: Celestial Orbit
response.text: Connecting... Target located.

response.speaker: Celestial Orbit
response.text: #<size=40><color=#FCD899>{REGEX#UNICODE[E000]} {REGEX#UNICODE[E002]} {REGEX#UNICODE[E001]}</color></size>

response.speaker: Celestial Orbit
response.text: Connection lost... Failed to locate target...

talks.objective: Enter the main control hall to search for the black kuuhenki
The lunar shuttle has been launched...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Is this escape pod broken?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's something glowing inside!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? She's here too? Does that mean there's something useful inside? But how do we get it out?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: While you think, the kuuhenki slips into the escape pod. A moment later, she returns — carrying an item.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is that?

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
dialogues.text: It's the spaceship's... archaeolune spectrometer...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, is that your voice? You can talk through this thing?

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
dialogues.text: Mmhmm... Power of the ancient moons... transmit messages...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? That sounds a lot like Phlogiston... Could this be dragon technology?

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
dialogues.text: Not...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you mean "no"?

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
dialogues.text: No... Not wrong...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Why do you pant so much when you talk?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It looks like the base and the spaceship were made by the dragons.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No wonder we ran into their Secret Source Automatons back there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But what does this all have to do with Columbina? Why did you turn into her?

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
dialogues.text: Columbina... Moon... Rescue...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did she run into trouble and send you to get help?

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
dialogues.text: Not...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
dialogues.text: Not right...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Can you... take it from the top and tell us the whole story? What exactly is going on?

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
dialogues.text: Columbina... rescued me... on the moon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? She rescued you? So she hasn't sent us a plea for help?

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
dialogues.text: That's... right...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then why did you tell us to get on this spaceship?

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
dialogues.text: I wanted to... go back to the moon...

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
dialogues.text: Not... you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no... In that case... what does that make us?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: People who came along of their own accord...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, no, how could this happen? We're not that clueless, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, you! You're leaving something out, aren't you? You said Columbina rescued you. That means you were in danger!

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
dialogues.text: Not...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not what this time? Not wrong? Not right?

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
dialogues.text: Not... sure...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Ugh, this is really starting to get on Paimon's nerves...

response.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
response.text: I'm sorry... I'm not sure...

response.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
response.text: When I woke up... I was very weak... I forgot... many things...

response.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
response.text: She took me to... a place of healing...

response.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
response.text: It was called... Silvermoon Hall...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh? Did Columbina tell you to stay there and rest? Then why did you come here?

response.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
response.text: ...I must... return to the moon...

response.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
response.text: ...There lies... my mission...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What mission?

response.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
response.text: ...I forgot...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How could you forget something like that!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So your home is on the moon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! You keep talking about going back to the moon... So you're not a local kuuhenki from Teyvat?

response.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
response.text: Yes... I belong on... the moon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is Columbina there right now?

response.speaker: Mysterious Kuuhenki
response.text: Yes... if... she hasn't left...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, that explains it! Paimon's got it all figured out now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Columbina wasn't in trouble... She just picked this kuuhenki up while strolling around the moon and sent her to Silvermoon Hall.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But our girl's got a little problem... she either doesn't talk at all, or has to pant her way to the finish line...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And now the two of us have gone whoosh and flown right out of Teyvat, like a couple of silly Anemo Slimes hit by an arrow!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... You tricked us, and that makes you a bad egg in Paimon's books! From now on, she's gonna call you, uhm... Eggie!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sob*... Good Hunter, Wanmin Restaurant, Shimura's... Will we ever meet again?

response.speaker: Eggie
response.text: ...I'm... sorry...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, hey... Are those tears...? Uhm, maybe Paimon was a little too mean? Please don't cry...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Psst, Eggie! Paimon isn't really this upset! She's just pretending so that {NICKNAME} might buy her more snacks later on...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you play along, we can split the snacks twenty-eighty... Alright?

response.speaker: Eggie
response.text: Snacks?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahem! Anyway... Eggie, you're the one who made us think Columbina was in danger! There's no way we could have sat back and done nothing knowing a friend was in trouble.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you have to take full responsibility for the situation we're in right now!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We can head back once we find Columbina.

response.speaker: Eggie
response.text: ...I can... help...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Then it's settled! Let's make this a surprise visit for Columbina! Who knows, maybe she'll be really happy to have friends come and play with her!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You cheered up quickly, hey, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahem... Well. Paimon suddenly realized that we'll soon be famous as the first adventurers to set foot on the moon! One small step for us, one big step for Teyvat, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And don't you start saying you've already been! Columbina helped you cheat, so that doesn't count.

response.speaker: Celestial Orbit
response.text: This vessel is about to enter lunar orbit. Please select a landing site.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! Are we almost there? Let's go check it out!

choices.text: We're already in flight. Might as well make our peace with it.

dialogues.speaker: Celestial Orbit
dialogues.text: This vessel is about to enter lunar orbit. Please select a landing site.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There are so many landing sites, but they all have super weird names... Which one should we pick?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Archaeolune Storm Research Center

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Eye of Ibni-Belum

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Moonheart Gap

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ungien's Circle

response.speaker: Celestial Orbit
response.text: Select another location.

response.speaker: Celestial Orbit
response.text: Connection established. Confirm landing thruster initiation?

response.speaker: Celestial Orbit
response.text: Connection established. Initiating landing thruster...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! Are we getting ready to land?
